title: binding-record
description: runtime/provisioner -> volume root: identity.json, the mailbox<->volume binding record. AMAP, section "Binding Record". INFORMATIONAL, NOT AUTHORITATIVE: the volume is agent-writable, so a consumer MUST treat contents as untrusted data and MUST tolerate the file's absence. Unlike the other runtime-authored documents, this schema is closed (section "Versioning") — its closure is an anti-secret-leak lint, not a compatibility surface.
